title: SeSQL: Yet Another Large-scale Session-level Chinese Text-to-SQL Dataset

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the statistical proportion of context-independent questions and easy-level SQL queries (e.g., "Dep. Ratio" and "Easy Ratio") to demonstrate complexity imbalances and structural artifacts in existing datasets.

Qualitatively observing the tendency of individual annotators to use limited, fixed linguistic patterns to advance question sessions, which was subsequently mitigated through an iterative multi-annotator workflow (though explicitly not measured via strict quantitative experiments).
